data.name: 3/4 sit-up
data.instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
2. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
3. Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight down by your sides.
2. Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, slowly bend your torso to one side, lowering your hand towards your knee.
3. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
4. Repeat on the other side.
5. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

data.name: air bike
data.instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with your hands placed behind your head.
2. Lift your legs off the ground and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle.
3. Bring your right elbow towards your left knee while simultaneously straightening your right leg.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the opposite side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee while straightening your left leg.
5. Continue alternating sides in a pedaling motion for the desired number of repetitions.

data.name: air twisting crunch
data.instructions:
1. Lie supine, knees lifted off the floor.
2. Rest the hands behind the head.
3. Raise the shoulders and rotate toward one knee.
4. Come back, then rotate toward the other knee.
5. Move slowly and keep the low back on the floor.
data.description: With both legs suspended, twist through each crunch to train the abs and the obliques.

data.name: band alternate biceps curl
data.instructions:
1. Plant both feet on the band's center and grip one free end in each hand.
2. Pin the elbows beside the ribs and turn the palms forward.
3. Bend one elbow so the fist climbs toward that shoulder.
4. Ease that arm down while the opposite fist starts rising.
5. Leave the upper arms quiet and stay upright instead of leaning away.
6. Trade arms on every repetition.
data.description: Alternate arms during a curl while both feet pin an elastic band. Tension climbs as each hand nears the shoulder.

data.name: barbell clean and press
data.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the floor in front of you.
2. Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to lift the barbell off the floor, keeping it close to your body.
4. As the barbell reaches your thighs, explosively extend your hips, shrug your shoulders, and pull the barbell up towards your chest.
5. As the barbell reaches chest height, quickly drop under it and catch it at shoulder level, with your elbows pointing forward and your palms facing up.
6. From the catch position, press the barbell overhead by extending your arms and pushing the barbell straight up.
7. Lower the barbell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
3. Bring your upper arms close to your sides, with your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
4. Extend your arms straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
5. Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.instructions:

data.instructions:

data.name: squat
data.instructions:

data.name: dumbbell burpee
data.instructions:
1. Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Lower your body into a squat position, placing the dumbbells on the ground in front of you.
3. Kick your feet back into a push-up position, keeping your body in a straight line.
4. Perform a push-up, bending your elbows and lowering your chest towards the ground.
5. Jump your feet back towards your hands, landing in a squat position.
6. Stand up explosively, lifting the dumbbells off the ground and bringing them to your shoulders.
7. Press the dumbbells overhead, fully extending your arms.
8. Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders and repeat the entire sequence for the desired number of repetitions.

data.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the ground in front of you.
2. Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower your torso and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Keep your back straight and chest lifted as you drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.

1. Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward, and arms fully extended.
2. Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
3. Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
4. Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
5. Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms and repeat.

1. Adjust the cable machine to chest height and attach the handles.
2. Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and step forward to create tension in the cables.
4. Position your feet firmly on the ground and engage your core.
5. Bend your elbows and bring your hands to shoulder level, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
6. Push the handles forward, extending your arms fully in front of you.
7. Pause for a moment, then slowly reverse the movement, bringing your hands back to shoulder level.
8. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.name: push-up
data.instructions:
1. Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
2. Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
3. Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.instructions:

1. Perch on a seat or on the ground and straighten one leg.
2. Aim the toes away so the dorsum of the foot gets longer.
3. Circle the ankle or press through it until the stretch feels easy.
4. Stay twenty to thirty seconds and do not force the range.
5. Let go and change legs.
6. Run it two or three times each side.
data.description: From a seat, gently lengthen the shin and the anterior ankle when they feel stiff after sitting or a session.

data.name: resistance band standing back achilles stretch
data.instructions:
1. Loop a band over the forefoot of the rear leg.
2. Hold both ends and stand upright.
3. Send that leg backward and plant the heel.
4. Tension the band so the toes travel toward the shin.
5. Stay twenty to thirty seconds with that rear knee fairly straight.
6. Change sides and go again.
data.description: With the leg stepped back, a band draws the toes toward the shin to lengthen the calf and Achilles.

data.name: resistance band standing forward achilles stretch
data.instructions:
1. Place a loop of band over the forefoot that is stepping forward.
2. Grip the ends and stand upright.
3. Plant the front heel and lift the toes.
4. Draw the band so the toes come toward you and tip the torso slightly ahead.
5. Stay twenty to thirty seconds in an easy stretch.
6. Change feet and go again.
data.description: Standing, draw the leading toes back with a band so the Achilles region lengthens.

data.name: single arm push up (on knees)
data.instructions:

data.instructions:

data.name: resistance band seated hip abduction
data.instructions:
1. Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
2. Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
3. Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.

6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.name: push-up plus
data.instructions:
1. Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
2. Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
3. Once your chest is just above the ground, push through your hands to extend your arms and lift your upper body up.

6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.name: chin tuck
data.instructions:
1. Sit or stand tall, gaze level.
2. Touch the chin with a finger if that helps you feel the motion.

6. Continue alternating sides, jumping and tapping the ground with each leg.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.name: barbell clean and press
data.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the floor in front of you.
2. Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to lift the barbell off the floor, keeping it close to your body.
4. As the barbell reaches your thighs, explosively extend your hips, shrug your shoulders, and pull the barbell up towards your chest.
5. As the barbell reaches chest height, quickly drop under it and catch it at shoulder level, with your elbows pointing forward and your palms facing up.
6. From the catch position, press the barbell overhead by extending your arms and pushing the barbell straight up.
7. Lower the barbell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.name: weighted sissy squat
data.instructions:

2. Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands, or place a barbell across your upper back.

6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

1. On your side or against a wall, ball under the side of the glute.
2. Lean in until the pressure feels firm yet still comfortable.
3. Glide only a couple of centimetres at a time.
4. If a sore point shows up, stay there and take calm breaths for about half a minute.
5. Breathe evenly, and skip bony landmarks and joints.
6. Do the same on the opposite side when that side needs it.
data.description: Use a compact massage ball on gluteus medius on the side of the hip to settle stiff tissue. It works well ahead of training or once the session ends.

data.name: butterfly yoga pose
data.instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
2. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall out to the sides.
3. Hold onto your ankles or feet with your hands.
4. Sit up tall and lengthen your spine.
5. Gently press your knees down towards the floor, feeling a stretch in your inner thighs.
6. Hold this position for a few breaths.
7. To release, slowly bring your knees back up and extend your legs.

data.name: all fours squad stretch
data.instructions:
1. Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
2. Extend one leg straight back, keeping your knee bent and your foot flexed.

5. Switch legs and repeat the stretch on the other side.

data.instructions:

2. Press the arms a little back and lift the chest without arching the low back.

data.name: band warm up shoulder stretch
data.instructions:
1. Both hands wide on a light band, in front of the thighs.
2. Arms long and the trunk braced.
3. Raise the band above the head and take it behind you only within comfort.
4. Come back along the same path.

data.name: curtsey squat
data.instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Take a step diagonally behind and across your body with your right foot, crossing it behind your left leg.
3. Bend both knees as if you were curtsying, lowering your body towards the ground.
4. Keep your torso upright and your weight on your front foot.
5. Push through your front foot to return to the starting position.
6. Repeat on the other side, stepping diagonally behind and across your body with your left foot.

1. Face-down, arms reaching forward.
2. Lift one leg just clear of the ground.
3. Make tight circles that stay under control.
4. After several circles, reverse direction.
5. Put it down and do the other leg.
6. Hips stay down and the middle stays braced.
data.description: Small prone leg circles in a swimming rhythm loosen the hips and train glute and trunk control.

data.name: bodyweight skipping
data.instructions:
1. Stand long, feet together.
2. Bound off one foot as the other knee comes up.
3. The opposite arm swings forward with the hop.
4. Switch in time with the skip.

6. Continue for half a minute to a minute.
data.description: No rope needed: light bounds and large arm swings raise the pulse and warm the legs.

data.name: triceps dip (bench leg)
data.instructions:
1. Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
2. Walk your feet forward, sliding your butt off the bench, and straighten your arms.

5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.name: cable pushdown
data.instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
2. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
3. Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
4. Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
5. Exhale and push the bar down until your elbows are fully extended.
6. Pause for a moment, then inhale and slowly return the bar to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

data.name: standing cross legs core stretch
data.instructions:

2. The arm matching the rear limb goes overhead.

data.description: With the limbs crossed, a standing side reach lengthens the flanks and eases the waist.

data.instructions:

data.description: The heel slides toward the hips and back, a gentle way to restore knee and hip bend.

data.name: lying supine straight knee raise
data.instructions:
1. Supine, one kneecap bent, the other limb long.
2. Thigh of the long limb tightens so the kneecap locks.

5. Descend unhurriedly to the ground.
6. Done, then swap limbs.
data.description: The knee stays locked as the straight limb lifts, gently waking the thigh and the hip flexors.

data.name: lying supine abdominal breathing
data.instructions:

2. Inhale unhurriedly through the nose.

5. Let the belly fall gently.
6. Continue one to two minutes.
data.description: Belly breathing on the back is a calm way to settle and to practice trunk control.
